B — COHEN'S KAPPA DERIVATION  |  κ = (P_o − P_e) / (1 − P_e)

WHY κ = 0.000 for GPT o3: GPT o3 predicts CLEAN for all 22 documents. Because the gold standard is 21/22 clean, the expected agreement under independence equals (21/22 × 22/22) + (1/22 × 0/22) = 0.9545 — exactly matching observed agreement 0.9545. κ = (0.9545 − 0.9545) / (1 − 0.9545) = 0.000. GPT o3's classification is statistically indistinguishable from always predicting the majority class, despite 95.5% raw accuracy.
